title: Compatibility with finite extensions of $E$
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum of [def-pur-conventions], with $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$, and a prime $\ell\ne p$. Let $X,Y$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes and $f:X\to Y$ a smooth separated finite-type $k$-morphism of pure relative dimension $d\geq0$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms, def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Let $E\subset F$ be finite extensions of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ inside a fixed algebraic closure, with valuation rings $\mathcal O_E\subset\mathcal O_F$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Use the derived-complete integral constructible categories [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed] and their raw scalar localizations $\Dbc(T,E)$ and $\Dbc(T,F)$ [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi]. The coefficient extension $C^T_{F/E}= -\otimes_E F$ is the rationalization of integral completed scalar extension, as defined there; the displayed tensor notation below denotes this functor, not tensor over a discrete constant non-torsion ring sheaf. Use compact supports [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support], pullback [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], and the Tate twists [def-coefficient-twists-detailed].

For $M\in\Dbc(X,E)$ and $K\in\Dbc(Y,E)$ there are natural isomorphisms
$$
\begin{aligned}
b_{F/E,M}: C^Y_{F/E}(Rf_{!,E}M)&\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf_{!,F}(C^X_{F/E}M),\\
a_{F/E,K}: C^X_{F/E}(Lf_E^*K(d)[2d])&\xrightarrow{\sim}Lf_F^*(C^Y_{F/E}K)(d)[2d],
\end{aligned}
$$
in $\Dbc(Y,F)$ and $\Dbc(X,F)$ respectively. They carry the unit and counit of the smooth purity adjunction $Rf_{!,E}\dashv Lf_E^*(-)(d)[2d]$ to those over $F$, where these adjunctions are obtained by scalar localization of the integral adjunction and its purity isomorphism in [det-sp-integral-adjunction-bijection]. For $E\subset F\subset L$, the comparisons for $E\subset L$ equal the composites for $E\subset F$ and $F\subset L$, under the scalar-extension associators [lem-weil-scalar-extension-composition].

proof.text: The rational coefficient comparisons stored in S preserve the exceptional adjunction unit and counit. Transport their left comparison along compactRealization at both endpoints. Expanding ofNatIsoLeft and cancelling its inverse pairs proves both exceptional adjunction equations in compactSupport coordinates. Apply lem-pur-purity-conjugated-coefficient-adjunction to gamma. Its conjugated source comparison equals a by the extracted purity square and cancellation of gamma_F. Its adjunction equals the displayed transported adjunction because their units agree. These identifications give exactly the two required smooth unit/counit equations.

proof.text: Transport the left coefficient identity and left coefficient cocycle stored in S along compactRealization. For identities use naturality of the scalar unitor and cancellation of the realization pair. For triples cancel the middle realization pair, use naturality of the scalar associator and the last realization, then apply the original left cocycle. The scalar unitors and associators are unchanged. Combine these with the source identities/cocycles already extracted.
